+## Run result (运行结果)
+
+How one run came out, in one set of words on every surface that shows it: the
+task page's 活动 rows, the right column's 活动 rows and the task conversation
+(`hooks/use-run-result.ts`), and iOS (`MobileCore.attempts`). A 活动 row shows
+the result of its Agent stretch's latest run. It is the run's own result, never
+the task's status: task status, Factory stage, run result and the derived
+受阻 / 等你处理 are four different things (#1687).
+
+| Result | 中文 | English | When |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| running | 运行中 | Running | The run is working. |
+| queued | 排队中 | Queued | The run waits for a machine. |
+| waiting | 等你回复 | Needs your reply | The run waits on the person; its reason may say more (等你确认, 待审阅). |
+| done | 完成 | Done | The run finished its work. |
+| failed | 失败 | Failed | The run failed. |
+| blocked | 受阻 | Blocked | The run stopped on something it cannot fix itself, such as 额度用完. |
+| idle | 暂不处理 | On hold | The run decided there is nothing to do now. |
+| ended | 已结束 | Ended | An earlier run left waiting while the conversation went on. |
+
+_Avoid_: 已解决 for a run (a thread group word, R-52), 已替换, 进行中 for a run
+(进行中 is the board column), 尝试.
+
 ## Other words
 
 Decided by Alex, 2026-10-28.

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import { runResult } from './use-run-result'
+
+// One set of words for how a run came out (glossary: Run result): the task page's and the right column's 活动 rows.
+test('the latest run reads as its own result', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'running' }, true), { result: 'running', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'queued' }, true), { result: 'queued', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'succeeded', outcome: 'done' }, true), { result: 'done', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'failed', outcome: 'failed' }, true), { result: 'failed', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'failed', outcome: 'blocked' }, true), { result: 'blocked', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'waiting_input' }, true), { result: 'waiting', reason: 'needsReply' })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'paused' }, true), { result: 'blocked', reason: 'quota' })
+})
+
+test('an earlier run keeps its result, except one left waiting, which has ended', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'succeeded', outcome: 'done' }, false), { result: 'done', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'failed', outcome: 'failed' }, false), { result: 'failed', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'failed', outcome: 'blocked' }, false), { result: 'blocked', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'waiting_input' }, false), { result: 'ended', reason: null })
+  assert.deepEqual(runResult({ status: 'succeeded', outcome: 'needs_input' }, false), { result: 'ended', reason: null })
+})

+'use client'
+
+import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl'
+import { localTaskState, type TaskReason } from '@/hooks/use-bot-tasks'
+
+/**
+ * How one run came out, in the one set of words for it (glossary: Run result). The task page's 活动 rows, the right
+ * column's 活动 rows and the task conversation's run lines all read it; iOS uses the same words (MobileCore.attempts).
+ * It is the run's own runtime result, never the task's status (#1687: task status, Factory stage, run status and
+ * blocked/needs-you are four things).
+ */
+export type RunResult = 'running' | 'queued' | 'waiting' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'blocked' | 'idle' | 'ended'
+
+/** An open task with no PRs: the run alone decides, as on a card that does not carry its task. */
+const OPEN_TASK = { status: 'doing', metadata: { pullRequests: [] } }
+
+/**
+ * A run by its own result, without its task's board status or PRs. `latest` is the task's current run: an earlier
+ * one that was left waiting on the person has ended, since the conversation went on past it. Every other earlier run
+ * keeps its own result (完成, 失败, 受阻).
+ */
+export function runResult(run: { status: string; outcome?: string | null }, latest: boolean): { result: RunResult; reason: TaskReason | null } {
+  const { state, reason } = localTaskState(OPEN_TASK, run)
+  const result: RunResult = state === 'canceled' || state === 'duplicate' ? 'done' : state === 'todo' ? 'idle' : state
+  if (!latest && result === 'waiting') return { result: 'ended', reason: null }
+  return { result, reason }
+}
+
+/** A run result's words: what it waits on (等你回复, 等你确认, 待审阅, 额度用完) when it says, else the result's name. */
+export function useRunResultLabel() {
+  const t = useTranslations('Shell.panel.task')
+  return (result: RunResult, reason: TaskReason | null) => reason ? t(`reason.${reason}`) : t(`result.${result}`)
+}
